| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-08-07T11:30:23Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-08-07T11:50:23Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND process.name == "sshd"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| EVAL user = CASE(message LIKE "*Accepted password for*", SUBSTRING(message, 23, LOCATE(message, " from ") - 23),
                   message LIKE "*Accepted publickey for*", SUBSTRING(message, 25, LOCATE(message, " from ") - 25),
                   message LIKE "*Failed password for invalid user*", SUBSTRING(message, 36, LOCATE(message, " from ") - 36),
                   message LIKE "*Failed password for*", SUBSTRING(message, 23, LOCATE(message, " from ") - 23),
                   message LIKE "*Invalid user*", SUBSTRING(message, 15, LOCATE(message, " from ") - 15),
                   "unknown"),
       auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*Accepted password*", "password",
                          message LIKE "*Accepted publickey*", "publickey",
                          message LIKE "*Failed password*", "password",
                          "other"),
       src_ip = CASE(message LIKE "* from * port*", SUBSTRING(message, LOCATE(message, " from ") + 6, LOCATE(message, " port ") - (LOCATE(message, " from ") + 6)),
                     "unknown")
| WHERE message LIKE "*Accepted*" OR message LIKE "*Failed password*" OR message LIKE "*Invalid user*"
| STATS first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY event.outcome, message, @timestamp, user, auth_method, src_ip
| SORT @timestamp ASC
| LIMIT 1000'
